purpose: Pre-Unity cinematic-intent QA for CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1. These checks protect authoring truth and do not replace Unity validation.

simpleV1Semantics.cinematicMove: Maps to existing V3 Beat/Feature vocabulary when exact; otherwise preserve visible evidence and lower-level legal actions without lying about a feature.
simpleV1Semantics.motionIntent: Semantic movement vocabulary including flyby, approach, orbit, intercept, pursuit, escort, rescue, landing, takeoff and human movement intents.
simpleV1Semantics.cameraOrbit: 2D/2.5D orbit-like parallax only. Never synthesize an unseen 3D side/back view.
simpleV1Semantics.performanceIntent: Resolved through existing performance/animation compatibility, never raw clip IDs.
simpleV1Semantics.audio: Direct CURRENT Audio handles only. Route, preview safety and publish safety remain authoritative.
simpleV1Semantics.continuity: Preserves screen direction and named continuity subjects between beats.

rules.description: The camera/creative focal target has no visible or entering evidence in the beat.
A camera move names a subject that is never visibly present during the beat.
A semantic cinematic move such as flyby, approach, orbit, intercept, pursuit or escort is flattened to a meaningless straight move without trajectory evidence.
Orbit intent exists but no legal 2D trajectory/parallax or existing Orbit-capable route can evidence it.
Orbit intent invents a 3D viewpoint, back side or model geometry not present in CURRENT visual evidence.
audio[].handle does not resolve exactly to CURRENT route Audio.
Audio is preview-usable but safeForPublish=false. Preview may continue, final publish-ready authoring must not claim readiness.
A performance/animation intent has no compatible CURRENT animation or deterministic fallback.
A declared left/right/ahead/behind/faces/threatens/follows/escorts/protects relationship is not reflected in visible staging.
preserveScreenDirection=true but matchedEntityIds is empty even though moving continuity-bearing entities exist.
A matched entity reverses established screen travel without an authored reason or transition.
An impact/destruction claim has no visible reaction, state change, effect or final-state evidence.
Dialogue presentation removes world evidence that the beat still depends on.
Three or more consecutive dialogue beats reuse effectively the same presentation, framing and transition.
A major physical story claim has no corresponding visible/action/effect evidence.
cinematicMove is declared but the beat contains no staging/camera/action evidence that expresses it.

hardAuthoringInvariants: AUTHORING_HANDLES.json is the only Simple V1 handle source.
Simple V1 does not author runtime assetId/GUID/revision/hash fields.
Unknown or ambiguous handles remain RED.
Audio handles must resolve to route Audio.
Orbit means legal 2D/2.5D screen/parallax evidence, never invented 3D.
Preview success is not publish readiness when any referenced CURRENT record has safeForPublish=false.
